workspaces._comment: Mirrors split-monitor-workspaces. monitorPriority MUST match the monitor_priority list in ~/.config/hypr/hyprland/plugins.lua, and perMonitor MUST match workspace_count.

theme._comment: 'dynamic' follows ~/.cache/hellwal/quickshell.json and recolours live on wallpaper change. Any other value loads theme/<name>.json - shipped: mocha, gruvbox.
theme.name: dynamic
